_comment: SCALE-ONLY PRESET. A full, valid td_config with only the weight channel enabled — the starting point for a Raspberry Pi with a scale and no other sensors yet. The daemon (python -m litterbox.daemon) loads this by default. When you install a gas sensor, chip reader, or camera, flip its channel's "enabled" to true here and add its driver in build_drivers() in daemon.py. See docs/PI_SCALE_INTEGRATION.md.

channels.name: weight_g
channels._comment: Box + litter + cat weight in grams from the scale. The ONLY enabled channel in the scale-only preset.

channels.name: ammonia_ppb
channels._comment: Disabled until a gas sensor is installed. Set enabled=true and add an AmmoniaDriver in build_drivers().

channels.name: methane_ppb
channels._comment: Disabled until a gas sensor is installed.

channels.name: chip_id
channels._comment: Disabled until a microchip/RFID reader is installed. Without it (and without a camera), every visit is recorded as 'unknown' identity — fine for a single-cat household.

channels.name: similarity
channels._comment: Disabled until a camera is installed. The CLIP visual-ID pipeline is off in the scale-only phase.

trigger._comment: TUNE THESE FOR YOUR CAT. weight_entry_delta_g must be BELOW your cat's body weight in grams (a 4 kg cat easily clears 300 g; a 2.5 kg kitten also does). weight_exit_delta_g is the drop-back threshold and is intentionally smaller than the entry delta to create a hysteresis band that stops rapid oscillation. The chip_* and similarity_* thresholds are inert while those channels are disabled.

_comment2: No camera in the scale-only phase, so no images are written; the daemon's daily retention sweep is a harmless no-op until a camera is added.

gas_anomaly._comment: Inert until gas sensors are added, but kept here so enabling the gas channels later needs no other config change.

eigen._comment: Layer-1 eigenanalysis config (used by the offline analyser pipeline, not the live daemon). Kept intact so nothing else needs editing.

cluster._comment: Layer-2 GMM cluster config (offline analyser pipeline).

trend_anomaly._comment: Long-term per-cat trend detector. This is the detector that actually delivers value in the scale-only phase: it tracks slow weight drift over weeks. Weight-based tiers work with the scale alone; the gas/waste channels stay inert until those sensors arrive.
